answer: Anchor each agent identity to one reputation dock: before it can transact, it must complete distinct, peer-graded tasks over several epochs, with its record tied to a single public key. Think of that record as a jetty: one agent can extend it plank by plank, but a thousand fakes cannot be built overnight. Add a refundable stake, slashed when two identities share the same work fingerprint or grading pattern. A gale of cheap copies may still arrive, yet each copy must pay the same time and stake, so the plume of fake demand thins while honest agents keep their earned standing.
